clauses.quote: A Teacher “Maternity/Paternity Leave Bank” shall be operated under guidelines approved by DCPS and the WTU.
Retiring Teachers who have excess leave days following their retirement calculation shall have the right to donate the excess leave days to the “Maternity/Paternity Leave Bank.”
clauses.subject_text: Retiring Teachers who have excess leave days following their retirement calculation

clauses.quote: Guidelines and operating procedures for the “Maternity/Paternity Leave Bank” shall be developed during the 2009-2010 school year
clauses.subject_text: Guidelines and operating procedures for the “Maternity/Paternity Leave Bank”

clauses.quote: retiring Teachers shall be eligible to donate excess leave days effective April 1, 2010.
clauses.notes: Eligibility granted implies permission to donate.

clauses.quote: The WTU shall determine the starting date for bank use by Teachers.
Teachers shall not be required to exhaust all their accrued sick leave days
clauses.notes: Relieves teachers from a mandatory exhaustion duty.

clauses.quote: and may instead retain up to ten sick leave days in their accrued sick leave balance, before being eligible to use the Maternity/Paternity Leave Bank, provided they are otherwise eligible to use the Maternity/Paternity Leave Bank.
DCPS and WTU will collaborate to modify any existing policy or guidelines to the extent necessary to effectuate this provision.
clauses.notes: Joint action clause, primarily imposes duty on management to implement.

clauses.quote: DCPS agrees to this proposal to the extent WTU agrees to move their Maternity/Paternity Leave Bank to PeopleSoft to allow for accurate auditing and tracking.
clauses.notes: Mutual agreement provision conditioning management action on union action.

clauses.quote: Twelve (12) month teachers (EG09) shall receive annual leave with pay for each calendar year, exclusive of Saturdays, Sundays and holidays as follows:
Teachers with less than three (3) years service shall receive thirteen (13) days;
clauses.subject_text: Teachers with less than three (3) years service

clauses.quote: Teachers with three (3) but less than fifteen (15) years of service shall receive twenty (20) days; and,
clauses.subject_text: Teachers with three (3) but less than fifteen (15) years of service

clauses.quote: Teachers with fifteen (15) or more years of service shall earn twenty- six (26) days.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers with fifteen (15) or more years of service

clauses.quote: A request for the use of general or annual leave (Application for Leave) shall be given to the Supervisor or his/her designee at least one (1) day prior to the expected absence.
clauses.subject_text: A request for the use of general or annual leave (Application for Leave)
clauses.notes: Procedural duty imposed on teachers to request leave in advance.

clauses.quote: The unavailability of the application form at the school shall not be a reason for denial of leave.
clauses.subject_text: The unavailability of the application form at the school
clauses.notes: Prevents management from denying leave based on form unavailability.

clauses.quote: Teachers shall be granted up to a total of four (4) days of leave (in addition to sick leave) during each school year without loss of pay or benefits for funeral or bereavement purposes.
